Overview

Radom is a city in Masovian with a population of 210,532. A historic city in central Poland with a rich industrial heritage, a growing business services sector, and a well-preserved old town. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
